blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Black-box distillation is a practical route for transferring capabilities from API-accessible large language models that expose only text outputs into smaller student models.
Recent on-policy adversarial methods such as GAD
improve over SeqKD by forming an adversarial loop between a critic and a student,
where the critic provides rewards for GRPO-based student policy optimization over the student’s sampled responses.
However, GRPO computes advantages from the within-group relative rewards of student samples for the same prompt, whereas the critic is trained primarily to distinguish teacher responses from student responses. This objective mismatch can produce reward groups with collapsed scale or fragile margins, leading to brittle grouped optimization signals.
We propose Groupwise Reward Geometry Conditioning (GRGC), a two-stage framework that improves advantage construction by shaping student-side reward groups during both critic training and policy optimization. To improve critic-side conditioning, Gaussian groupwise Optimal Transport calibration regularizes the critic during training to produce reward groups with non-collapsed spread and smooth rank-wise gaps by matching sorted prompt-wise rewards to group-centered Gaussian quantiles.
Building on this conditioned reward geometry, policy-side group power modulation reshapes the prompt-wise reward groups before they are converted into advantages, preserving the critic-induced ordering while increasing optimization-relevant margin separability. Extensive experiments across diverse teachers, student model families and scales, and training datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of GRGC on both in-distribution and out-of-distribution evaluations, while introducing negligible overhead over GAD.
The code is available at https://github.com/2018cx/GRGC .

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Large language models (LLMs) have achieved strong performance across NLP tasks [ 1 , 2 , 3 ] , but their scale leads to high computational and deployment costs [ 4 , 5 , 6 ] . Knowledge distillation (KD) mitigates this issue by transferring capabilities from large teacher models to smaller students [ 7 , 8 , 9 ] . Most existing KD methods assume a white-box setting, where internal teacher signals such as logits and hidden states are accessible, enabling objectives based on distribution and representation alignment [ 10 , 11 , 12 ] . However, modern frontier LLMs are typically accessible only via text-generation APIs [ 13 , 14 , 15 , 16 ] , which restricts supervision to sampled outputs and defines the black-box distillation setting. In this regime, standard white-box objectives become inapplicable, making distillation fundamentally more challenging and necessitating new learning paradigms [ 17 , 18 ] .
blocks.zh: 大型语言模型(LLMs)在NLP任务[1,2,3]中取得了强劲的性能,但其规模导致高计算和部署成本[4,5,6]. 知识蒸馏(KD)通过将能力从大型教师模式转移到较小的学生[7,8,9]来缓解这一问题. 大多数现有的 KD 方法假设一个白盒设置,其中可以访问内部的老师信号,如日志和隐藏状态,基于分布和表示对齐[10,11,12]的赋能目标. 然而,现代前沿有限责任公司通常只能通过文本生成API[13,14,15,16]获取,这限制了监督对输出物进行抽样,并定义了黑箱蒸馏设置. 在这个制度中,标准白箱目标变得不适用,使提炼从根本上更具挑战性,并需要新的学习范式[17、18]。

blocks.en: Early black-box distillation methods [ 19 , 20 , 21 ] typically adopt sequence-level knowledge distillation (SeqKD) [ 22 ] , which treats teacher-generated responses as supervised targets for direct student training. SeqKD is simple and scalable, but it is fundamentally off-policy: the student is trained on teacher trajectories and then tested on its own rollouts, leading to exposure bias and a persistent train-test mismatch. This limitation has motivated recent moves toward on-policy black-box distillation [ 23 , 18 , 17 ] . Among these directions, on-policy adversarial distillation [ 18 , 24 ] is particularly attractive because it replaces continual online teacher scoring with a learned critic, making training more cost-effective than approaches that repeatedly query the teacher during policy optimization. This practical advantage, however, exposes a sharper critic-to-advantage interface problem. The critic is trained to assign higher scores to teacher responses than to student responses, but GRPO updates the student from prompt-wise advantages computed only over the student’s own sampled response group. Because the critic objective does not explicitly constrain the gaps, ordering robustness, or scale of this student-only reward group, these geometric properties can deteriorate even when teacher–student discrimination improves. Our analysis and propositions show that this deterioration directly affects advantage construction: low within-group dispersion makes the student-side ordering fragile under critic noise, while weak group scale amplifies noise sensitivity in the downstream advantage signal.
blocks.zh: 早期黑箱蒸馏方法[19,20,21]一般采用序列级知识蒸馏法(SeqKD)[22],该方法将教师生成的响应作为直接学生培训的受监督的目标. SeqKD是简单且可扩展的,但是它从根本上脱离了政策:学生接受教师轨迹培训,然后自己推出测试,导致曝光偏差和持续的列车测试不匹配. 这一限制促使最近朝着政策黑盒蒸馏[23、18、17]的方向发展。 在这些方向中,政策对抗式提炼[18,24]特别有吸引力,因为它用一位有学问的批评家取代了持续的在线教师评分,使得培训比在政策优化期间反复询问教师的方法更具成本效益。 然而,这种实际优势暴露了更为尖锐的批评者对优势的界面问题. 评论家接受训练,为教师的回答分配比学生的回答高的分数,但GPRO从仅比学生自己的抽样回答组迅速计算出的优势来更新学生. 因为批评者的目标并没有明确限制差距、命令强健性或这个仅限学生的奖励团体的规模,即使教师-学生的歧视有所改善,这些几何属性也会恶化。 我们的分析与命题表明,这种恶化直接影响优势构建:群体内部分散程度低,使得学生一方在批评者噪声下下令脆弱,而弱群体尺度则放大下游优势信号中的噪声敏感度.

blocks.en:
We call this groupwise reward geometry mismatch. To address it, we propose Groupwise Reward Geometry Conditioning (GRGC),
which intervenes at two coupled stages: critic-side formation of student reward groups and their policy-side use in GRPO.
Gaussian groupwise Optimal Transport (OT) calibration acts during critic training, at the source where critic scores form the raw student-side reward group.
It uses an efficient OT-based objective to align the sorted rewards in each prompt group with group-centered Gaussian quantiles, chosen for their symmetric, moderate rank-gap profile, thereby inducing a non-degenerate spread, a stable scale, and a smooth ordered gap profile.
This geometry is optimization-relevant: it makes within-group comparisons less prone to ranking flips and less sensitive to perturbations.
Policy-side group modulation then acts on this conditioned reward geometry.
After critic-side geometry calibration reduces collapse and scale drift, centering and scaling each reward group yields standardized scores with more reliable relative positions.
In this regime, our analysis shows that the signed power transform preserves the critic-induced ordering and enlarges informative within-group margins under bounded perturbations, yielding more separable reward groups for GRPO-based student policy training.
Our propositions further make this optimization link explicit: in a grouped softmax surrogate, advantage gaps exactly determine one-step pairwise log-odds shifts, while advantage errors induce bounded distortion in the clipped GRPO surrogate.

blocks.en: Our overall pipeline is illustrated in Figure 1 , and our contributions are summarized as follows: • We identify the groupwise reward-geometry mismatch in on-policy adversarial black-box distillation, where the critic can learn effective teacher–student discrimination while producing student-side reward groups that are poorly conditioned for GRPO advantage estimation. • We propose GRGC, a lightweight framework for effective advantage construction: critic-side geometry calibration first stabilizes prompt-wise reward groups, and policy-side group modulation then amplifies informative margins on the conditioned signal. • Experiments across diverse teachers, student model families and scales, and training datasets show consistent gains on in-distribution and out-of-distribution benchmarks, supported by different auto-judging models, evaluation metrics, and human preference evaluation.

blocks.en: 2 Related Works
blocks.zh: 2 相关工程

blocks.en: Teacher-based LLM distillation methods are broadly divided into white-box and black-box distillation.
blocks.zh: 基于教师的LLM蒸馏法大致分为白箱蒸馏法和黑箱蒸馏法.

blocks.en: 2.1 White-box Knowledge Distillation of LLMs
blocks.zh: 2.1 远程教育知识的白盒化

blocks.en:
White-box knowledge distillation leverages full access to the teacher’s internal states, such as token-level probabilities and hidden representations, to guide student learning [ 25 , 26 ] .
Traditional methods mainly align output distributions with forward Kullback–Leibler (KL) divergence [ 10 , 11 ] , but some studies show that forward KL encourages mode-covering behavior, which can overburden limited-capacity students [ 11 , 27 ] .
To address this,
MiniLLM [ 11 ] and GKD [ 12 ] use reverse KL divergence to promote mode-seeking behavior, ensuring the student focuses on the teacher’s high-confidence reasoning paths. Furthermore, structural distillation through intermediate features, such as hidden states and attention maps in TinyBERT [ 28 ] , has proven essential for deep architectural imitation.
Beyond direct distribution matching, MMKD [ 29 ] formulates distillation as adversarial action-value moment matching.
Recent studies have explored cross-tokenizer knowledge distillation to overcome conventional KD’s reliance on identical teacher–student tokenizers and enable cross-family model transfer.
ULD [ 30 ] addresses vocabulary misalignment by using the Wasserstein distance to align disparate token spaces. DSKD [ 31 ] unifies prediction spaces through bidirectional linear projections and an Exact Token Alignment algorithm. Complementary approaches like ALM [ 32 ] and DistillMoE [ 33 ] explore approximate likelihood matching and mixture-of-experts strategies to further stabilize cross-tokenizer knowledge transfer.
However, white-box distillation is impractical for state-of-the-art models such as GPT-5 [ 13 ] and Doubao-Seed [ 34 ] , whose internal states are typically inaccessible.
blocks.zh:
白盒知识蒸馏可以充分利用教师的内部状态,如象征性的概率和隐藏的表示,来指导学生的学习[25,26].
传统方法主要将输出分布与前向Kullback – Leibler(KL)差异[10,11]对齐,但一些研究表明,前向KL鼓励模式覆盖行为,这可能会让有限的学生负担过重[11,27].
为了解决这个问题,
MiniLLM [11] 和 GKD [12] 使用反向 KL 差异来推广寻求模式的行为,确保学生专注于老师的高自信推理路径. 此外,通过中间特征进行结构蒸馏,例如隐藏状态和TinyBERT[28]中的注意图,已证明对深层建筑模仿至关重要。
除了直接分布匹配外,MMKD[29]还提出蒸馏作为对抗性动作值瞬间匹配.
最近的研究探索了交叉调试器知识蒸馏法,以克服传统的KD依赖相同的师生代号器,并促成跨家庭模式转移。
ULD [30] 通过使用Wasserstein的距离来对齐不同的符号空间来解决词汇错配. DSKD [31] 通过双向线性预测和精确托肯对齐算法统一预测空间. ALM[32]和DistillMoE[33]等补充办法探讨大致可能性匹配和专家混合战略,以进一步稳定交叉知识转让。
然而,白箱蒸馏对于GPT-5[13]和Doubao-Seed[34]等最先进的模型来说是不切实际的,其内部状态通常无法进入.

blocks.en: 2.2 Black-box Knowledge Distillation of LLMs
blocks.zh: 2.2 有限责任公司的知识扭曲

blocks.en:
Black-box distillation uses only observable teacher outputs rather than internal teacher signals.
The dominant paradigm is SeqKD [ 22 ] , which treats teacher responses as supervised labels and has supported many open-source instruction-tuned models [ 19 , 20 , 35 , 36 ] . However, SeqKD is inherently off-policy and therefore vulnerable to exposure bias and distribution shift [ 37 , 38 ] . To enrich supervision under this paradigm, later works have explored richer reasoning traces [ 39 , 40 , 41 , 42 , 21 , 43 ] .
Motivated by the success of white-box on-policy distillation [ 11 , 12 , 44 ] , recent works have extended this idea to black-box distillation [ 23 , 18 ] .
OVD [ 23 ] obtains on-policy supervision by repeatedly querying the black-box teacher for verbal scores on student-generated trajectories.
While effective, this teacher-in-the-loop design incurs substantial inference cost.
GAD [ 18 ] instantiates adversarial distillation by introducing a critic model that is trained alternately with the student under a GAN-style minimax objective.
The critic provides online rewards for student-generated responses, which are converted into prompt-wise advantages for GRPO-based policy optimization, while offline-generated teacher responses can be reused throughout training to avoid continual teacher querying.
However, replacing online teacher supervision with an online critic shifts the key challenge to the critic-to-advantage interface. We address this bottleneck by calibrating groupwise reward geometry.
blocks.zh:
黑盒蒸馏只使用可观察到的教师输出而不是教师内部信号.
占主导地位的范式是 SeqKD [22] ,该范式将教师的响应作为有监督的标签,并支持了许多开源指令调制模型 [19, 20, 35, 36]. 然而,SeqKD本质上是政策外的,因此容易受到暴露偏差和分布转移的影响[37、38]。 为了丰富这一范式下的监督,后来的作品探索了更丰富的推理痕迹[39,40,41,42,21,43].
以白盒政策蒸馏的成功[11,12,44]为动机,近期的作品将这一想法扩展到黑盒蒸馏[23,18].
OVD [23]通过反复询问黑盒老师在学生生成的轨迹上的口头分数来获得政策监督.
虽然这种“落地教师”设计很有效,但需要大量推论费用。
GAD [18]通过引入一个在GAN风格微型目标下与学生交替训练的批评模型,来即时进行对抗式蒸馏.
评论家为学生生成的响应提供在线奖励,这些响应被转化为基于GRPO的政策优化的即时优势,而线下生成的教师响应则可以在整个培训过程中重复使用,以避免教师持续查询.
然而,以在线评论家取代在线教师监督将关键挑战转移至评论家对优势界面. 我们通过校准团体奖励几何来解决这个瓶颈。

blocks.en: 3.2 Revisiting On-policy Adversarial Black-Box Distillation
blocks.zh: 3.2 重新审查政策上的有害的黑牛蒸馏

blocks.en:
To reduce the risk of reward hacking against a fixed reward model, on-policy adversarial black-box distillation [ 18 , 24 ] instantiates black-box distillation through an alternating student–critic training loop within a grouped policy optimization framework. For each prompt x x , the student policy π θ \pi_{\theta} samples a response group { G ​ ( x ) i } i = 1 N \{G(x)_{i}\}_{i=1}^{N} , where N N is the group size.
The critic, serving as an online reward model, assigns sequence-level scores to both
student responses and the teacher response y y ; these scores are used
to form the critic’s adversarial training objective.
The student-side scores are then used as rewards to construct within-group
advantages for GRPO-based optimization of π θ \pi_{\theta} .

blocks.en: GAD [ 18 ] trains the critic model with a Bradley–Terry-style objective: ℒ BT ( x ) = 1 N ∑ i = 1 N − log σ ( D ( y ) − D ( G ( x ) i ) ) , \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{BT}}(x)=\frac{1}{N}\sum_{i=1}^{N}-\log\sigma\!\left(D(y)-D(G(x)_{i})\right), (1) where D ⁡ ( ⋅ ) D(\cdot) is the critic score and σ ⁡ ( ⋅ ) \sigma(\cdot) is the logistic sigmoid. The core mismatch is especially relevant in adversarial black-box distillation, where the critic is updated online rather than calibrated as a general preference evaluator. blocks.en: 3.3 Calibrating Groupwise Reward Geometry for Effective Advantage Construction
blocks.zh: 3.3 有效优势建筑的校准组

blocks.en:
The geometry mismatch above motivates an intervention at the critic-to-advantage interface. To address this, we explicitly condition prompt-wise reward group geometry for effective advantage construction.
The preceding analysis shows that student-side critic rewards must avoid collapse, maintain stable within-group scale, and preserve sufficient separation for reliable advantage estimation. Additionally, prior studies [ 46 ] emphasize the importance of stable within-group variance for this estimation, both of which motivate the need for critic-side geometry calibration.
While geometry calibration improves conditioning, it does not actively sharpen the informative margins needed for early grouped policy separation. To address this, we introduce policy-side group modulation, which amplifies useful grouped margins before deriving the final advantages.
GRGC, therefore, consists of two complementary components: (1) Critic-side geometry calibration (CGC): During critic training, an OT objective regularizes reward groups toward well-separated, non-collapsed, and variance-stable geometry. (2) Policy-side group modulation (PGM): During policy optimization, a group power transform reshapes critic rewards before the final prompt-wise advantages are computed for GRPO.
blocks.zh:
上面的几何错配激发了批评者对优势界面的干预. 为了解决这个问题,我们明确将迅速奖励团体几何条件作为有效优势构建的条件。
上述分析表明,学生方面的批评者奖励必须避免崩溃,保持群体内部的稳定规模,并保持充分的分离,以便进行可靠的优势估计。 此外,以前的研究[46]强调,这一估算必须保持组内稳定的差异,这二者都促使有必要对批评方几何进行校准。
虽然几何校准能改善条件,但并不积极提高早期分组政策分离所需的信息空间。 为了解决这一问题,我们引入了政策侧组调法,在获得最终优势之前,扩大了有益的分组幅度。
因此,GRGC由两个相辅相成的组成部分组成: (1)批评侧几何校准(CGC): 在批评者训练期间,一个OT目标将奖励团体正规化,使之走向分明、不折不扣和变化稳定的几何学。 (2) 政策侧组调制: 在政策优化期间,在为GRPO计算出最后的即时优势之前,集体动力转换会重塑批评者的奖励.

blocks.en: During critic training, we regularize each prompt-wise student reward group toward a reference geometry. The goal is to impose an optimization-friendly within-group structure: the group should avoid collapse, maintain a controlled spread, and provide smoothly varying rank-wise gaps. We use a Gaussian quantile template to provide balanced geometry within a symmetric location-scale family, preventing rigid spacing and excessive tail emphasis, and producing reward groups that are suitable for subsequent advantage construction.

blocks.en: Proposition 4 corresponds to Proposition 4.1 in Appendix C and shows that CGC penalizes collapse and scale mismatch. Proposition 4.2 shows that OT penalizes ordered shape mismatch even when variance is matched, Proposition 4.3 establishes optimal mean anchoring and translation invariance, and Proposition 10 shows that Gaussian quantiles induce a more suitable interior-to-tail gap profile than linear or heavier-tailed alternatives. These analyses show that CGC is not only a variance regularizer, but a group-centered conditioner of the full ordered reward geometry.

blocks.en:
Critic-side calibration encourages the critic to emit stable, non-collapsed, and structurally regular reward groups, providing a well-conditioned geometry for grouped optimization. Building on this calibrated geometry, we apply a group power transform before final prompt-wise advantage computation to convert useful within-group differences into sufficiently decisive advantage gaps while preserving the critic-induced ordering.
By retaining relative magnitude information and enlarging informative margins with a controlled polynomial gain, this transform makes the resulting reward groups more responsive to grouped optimization.

通过保留相对数量信息,并增加信息空间,以控制的多边收益,这种转变使由此产生的奖励团体更能适应分组优化。

blocks.en: Proposition 5 shows that PGM preserves ordering while enlarging already informative gaps. The proof is given in Appendix C . Proposition 11 in the appendix formalizes the structural requirements for a pre-advantage transformation: it should preserve order, treat both sides symmetrically, apply a scale-consistent gain rule, and introduce no extra shape parameters. Under these requirements, the signed power form is uniquely determined among common transforms. Proposition 6 in the appendix further shows that the enlarged margins remain valid under bounded noise in the informative regime.

The two components above define the mechanism chain of GRGC: CGC improves the geometry of rewards emitted by the critic, and PGM turns that geometry into more separable transformed rewards. In the grouped softmax surrogate analyzed in Appendix C , let π i ​ ( θ ) \pi_{i}(\theta) and π j ​ ( θ ) \pi_{j}(\theta) denote the policy probabilities assigned to candidates i i and j j within the same prompt group. (13) Thus, reward geometry determines transformed reward separability, which determines the advantage gaps driving one-step policy separation in the grouped softmax surrogate. Proposition 8 shows that misranked constructed advantages can make this movement fail to improve the desired pairwise preference, or even move in the wrong direction. Proposition 9 connects this mechanism to clipped GRPO: errors in the constructed advantages induce bounded distortion of the clipped surrogate, so improving advantage conditioning and separability matter for the actual policy objective.

blocks.en: 4 Experiments
blocks.zh: 4 实验

blocks.en: 4.1 Experimental Settings
blocks.zh: 4.1 实验设置

blocks.en:
Datasets. We evaluate our method on two complementary datasets for assistant response generation, covering distinct data distributions.
(1) LMSYS-Chat : We primarily use a subset of the LMSYS-Chat-1M dataset [ 48 ] preprocessed by GAD [ 18 ] , which represents large-scale, diverse, and spontaneous user-chatbot interactions.
(2) Dolly-Train : To further evaluate performance on human-authored instruction data, we adopt the MiniLLM-processed Dolly training data released on Hugging Face [ 11 ] .
blocks.zh:
数据集. 我们用两个辅助数据集来评价我们的方法,用于助理响应生成,涵盖不同的数据分布。
(1) LMSYS-Chat: 我们主要使用由GAD[18]预处理的LMSYS-Chat-1M数据集的子集[48],它代表了大规模,多样,自发的用户-聊天器交互.
(2) 多莉火车: 为了进一步评价人类授权的教学数据的表现,我们采用了Hugging Face上发布的MiniLLM处理的Dolly训练数据[11].

blocks.en: Models. We evaluate our method under black-box distillation from two API-based teachers, GPT-5 [ 13 ] and Doubao-Seed-2.0 [ 34 ] . Teacher responses are generated through their official APIs, with thinking mode enabled for Doubao-Seed-2.0. As students, we use two small-model families: Qwen2.5-Instruct at 1.5B and 3B scales [ 49 ] , and Llama-3.2-Instruct at 1B and 3B scales [ 50 ] .
blocks.zh: 模特儿们 我们从两位基于API的教师,GPT-5[13]和Doubao-Seed-2.0[34],来评价我们在黑盒蒸馏下的方法. 教师的反应通过官方的API产生,为Doubao-Seed-2.0启用思维模式. 作为学生,我们使用两个小模范家庭:Quen2.5-Instruct在1.5B和3B比例尺[49];Llama-3.2-Instruct在1B和3B比例尺[50].

blocks.en:
Baselines and Evaluation. We compare GRGC with offline-teacher-response black-box distillation baselines, i.e., methods that learn from pre-generated teacher outputs without additional online teacher queries: SeqKD [ 22 ] and GAD [ 18 ] .
Following GAD, evaluation covers both in-distribution and OOD benchmarks: a 479-sample LMSYS held-out test set, DollyEval [ 51 ] with 500 samples, SelfInst [ 52 ] with 242 user-oriented instructions, and VicunaEval [ 20 ] with 80 complex open-ended queries.
We use Qwen2.5-72B [ 49 ] as the main LLM-as-a-judge, with details in Appendix F . Additional GPT-OSS-120B-based [ 53 ] and human evaluations are reported in Appendix G .
blocks.zh:
基线和评价。 我们比较了GRGC与离线-教师-应答黑盒蒸馏基线,即从预生成的教师产出中学习的方法,而无需额外的在线教师询问:SeqKD[22]和GAD[18].
在GAD之后,评价既包括分配,也包括OOD基准:一个479-样本LMSYS的搁置测试集,DollyEval[51]有500个样本,SelfInst[52]有242个面向用户的指令,VicunaEval[20]有80个复杂的开放式查询.
我们使用Quen2.5-72B[49]作为主要LLM-as-a-judge,详情见附录F。 附录G中报告了其他基于GPT-OSS-120B的[53]和人类评价。

blocks.en: Implementation Details. All main results are trained for a total of 2 epochs. For GAD and our approach, the process consists of 1 epoch of supervised warmup followed by 1 epoch of adversarial training. We use a global batch size of 128. Following GAD [ 18 ] , the learning rate is set to 5 × 10 − 6 5\times 10^{-6} for SeqKD, and 1 × 10 − 6 1\times 10^{-6} for both stages in GAD and our method. The group size is N = 8 N=8 , the KL weight is β = 0.001 \beta=0.001 , and the training temperature is set to 0.8. The critic is initialized from the student model’s parameters and extended with an additional head to serve as the reward model. The maximum context length is 2,048 tokens for prompts and 1,536 tokens for responses, with responses from the Doubao - Seed - 2.0 teacher capped at 2,048 tokens. Our OT weight is λ OT = 0.01 \lambda_{\text{OT}}=0.01 , and the group power hyperparameter is γ = 1.5 \gamma=1.5 . Experiments are conducted on 8 NVIDIA A100 GPUs.

blocks.en:
GPT-5-Teacher Results. Table 2 shows that GRGC achieves the best results across all reported students and test sets.
This pattern appears in both averaged scores and reference-based win rates, indicating consistent gains across metrics and stronger preference relative to the reference answers.
These results are consistent with our central claim that better reward geometry improves grouped optimization and adversarial black-box distillation.
GPT-OSS-120B judging and human preference evaluation show the same trend as the
Qwen2.5-72B evaluation.
Appendix G reports these evaluations, along with judge-free IFEval, Math500, and long-form mathematical-reasoning tests, sensitivity analyses on λ OT \lambda_{\text{OT}} and γ \gamma , and token-length analysis.
The confidence intervals in Tables 20 and 21 further demonstrate the robustness of our improvement.

这些结果与我们的核心主张是一致的,即更好的奖励几何学改进了分组优化和对抗式黑箱蒸馏.

Doubao-Seed-2.0 Teacher Results. With thinking mode enabled, Doubao-Seed-2.0 produces longer and more structured responses, making it a more challenging teacher to distill.
Comparing the LMSYS-Chat results in Tables 2 and 3 , Doubao-Seed-2.0 achieves higher teacher win rates than GPT-5-Chat.
GRGC helps student models better approximate Doubao-Seed-2.0’s response behavior, as reflected by improved reference-based win rates.
Table 4 shows that GRGC maintains its advantage when trained on Dolly-Train, demonstrating generalization beyond the LMSYS dataset distribution.

杜宝-种子-2.0 教师成果. 随着思维模式的启用,杜宝-种子2.0产生更长和更结构化的响应,使它成为一个更具有挑战性的教师来蒸馏.
与表2和表3的LMSYS-Chat结果相比,Doubao-Seed-2.0的教师胜率高于GPT-5-Chat。
GRGC帮助学生模型更接近Doubao-Seed-2.0的反应行为,这体现在基于参考的胜率的提高上.
表4显示,GRGC在接受Dolly-Train培训时保持其优势,显示了LMSYS数据集分布之外的泛化.

blocks.en: Impact of the two components. Table 6 verifies the intended interaction between CGC and PGM. CGC alone gives strong results after two adversarial epochs, showing that critic-side geometry calibration improves optimization by preventing reward collapse and scale instability. Its 1-epoch gain is smaller, and on Qwen2.5-3B it is even below GAD, because early OT calibration mainly organizes the reward geometry rather than immediately making the top student candidates more separated. PGM addresses exactly this early-stage gap: after group centering and scaling, the signed power transform preserves the critic-induced order while enlarging informative standardized differences, producing more decisive advantage gaps for the policy update. Combining the two therefore gives both well-conditioned critic rewards from CGC and stronger early advantage separation from PGM.
blocks.zh: 这两部分的影响。 表6核实了理事会与项目组合和小组之间的预期互动。 光是CGC在两个对抗时代之后就给出了强烈的结果,表明批评方几何校准通过防止奖励崩溃和规模不稳定来改进优化. 它的1世纪增益较小,在Qwen2.5-3B上甚至低于GAD,因为早期OT校准主要组织奖励几何,而不是立即让顶尖学生考生更加分离. PGM完全解决了这个早期的空白:在分组中心化和规模化之后,签名的动力转换保留了批评者引起的秩序,同时扩大了信息化的标准化差异,为政策更新带来了更决定性的优势差距. 因此,将两者结合起来,既能从CGC中获得条件良好的批评者奖赏,也能从PGM中获得更强大的早期优势。

blocks.en:
Discussion of CGC. Table 6 shows that Gaussian CGC gives the strongest results among the tested conditioning priors.
Variance-only calibration helps by reducing the most obvious collapse, but it does not constrain how gaps are allocated across ranks. Linear targets impose non-collapsed but overly rigid equal spacing, while Laplace and logistic targets introduce heavier tails that allocate too much separation to extreme-ranked samples. Gaussian OT gives the best trade-off by matching ordered rewards to a non-collapsed, symmetric, and smoothly varying reference geometry with moderate tail emphasis.
Details of these alternatives and more mechanism analysis are provided in Appendix C .
blocks.zh:
讨论CGC. 表6显示,高斯式CGC在测试的前置条件中给出的结果最强.
仅靠差异校准有助于减少最明显的崩溃,但并不限制各等级的差距分配。 线性目标规定了无折叠但过于僵硬的等距,而拉普拉斯和后勤目标则引入了更重的尾巴,将过多的分离分配给极位样本. Gaussian OT通过将订购的奖励比对一个不折不扣,对称,平稳变化的参考几何,并适度强调尾部,从而给予最好的权衡.
这些替代品的详细情况和更多的机制分析载于附录C。

blocks.en: Discussion of PGM. Table 8 shows that group power is the strongest reward-shaping choice among the tested alternatives. Its advantage is that it preserves the critic-implied ordering while placing larger gain on already separated grouped margins. This keeps the critic’s magnitude information while avoiding the overly sparse update induced by Top-1 and the margin-information loss induced by CDF or Rank [ 54 ] remapping. More mechanism-level comparison is provided in Appendix C .
blocks.zh: 讨论PGM. 表8显示,在经过测试的替代品中,团体力量是最强的奖励-塑造选择。 它的优点是,它保留了批评者所暗示的订单,同时将更大的收益放在已经分开的分组边际上。 这保持了评论者的数量信息,同时避免了Top-1引起的更新过于稀少,以及CDF或Rank[54]重新绘图引起的差值信息损失。 附录C提供了更多的机制层面的比较。

blocks.en: Runtime analysis. GRGC operates on the scalar reward groups already produced by the critic, adding only sorting, normalization, OT matching, and elementwise reward modulation without introducing extra model forward or backward passes. Table 8 confirms that this low-order overhead is negligible and largely insensitive to model size: the measured overhead is only 0.11 % 0.11\% for Qwen2.5-1.5B and 0.06 % 0.06\% for Qwen2.5-3B. A more detailed complexity analysis is provided in Appendix H .
blocks.zh: 运行时间分析. GRCS在评论家已经制作的标尺奖励组上运作,只添加排序,正常化,OT匹配,元素奖励调制而不引入额外的型号前向或后向通行证. 表8证实,这种低订单的间接费用可以忽略不计,基本上对模型大小不敏感:所测量的间接费用在Quen2.5-1.5B中仅为0.11%.,在Quen2.5-3B中仅为0.06%.06%. 附录H提供了更详细的复杂性分析。

blocks.en:
Visualizations. The qualitative geometry diagnostics align closely with the quantitative gains. Fig. 4 shows that GRGC keeps the relative prompt-group reward spread within a more controlled range than GAD, suggesting improved critic-side conditioning for effective advantage construction. Figure 8 shows that GRGC reduces collapsed prompt groups, while Fig. 9 shows that it also reduces weak-margin groups. Figure 10 further reports the unnormalized prompt-group reward spread with uncertainty bands.
These diagnostics support the proposed reward-geometry conditioning mechanism.
blocks.zh:
可视化. 质的几何诊断与量的增益密切相关. 图4显示,GRGC将相对的即时群奖励分布在比GAD更受控制的范围内,建议改进批评方条件,以有效构建优势. 图8显示GRGC减少了崩溃的即时群,图9显示它也减少了弱边际群. 图10还报告了未规范的即时团体奖励随不确定波段而蔓延的情况。
这些诊断支持提议的奖励-几何调节机制.

blocks.en:
Direct advantage analysis. Table 9 reconstructs both methods’ final advantages using their respective reward transformations under the same population z-score convention. The top-2 gap is the difference between the largest and second-largest advantages within each prompt group.
GRGC yields larger gaps, fewer near ties, and stronger top-1 and pairwise retention, demonstrating better separation and perturbation stability of the final GRPO advantages.
Table 10 further shows that additional sampling alone does not resolve low dispersion. Here batch size counts prompts per update, group size counts responses per prompt, and low dispersion denotes relative std < 0.15 <0.15 . Increasing either the number of prompts per update or the number of responses per prompt provides only limited improvement for GAD, whereas GRGC consistently maintains substantially lower low-dispersion frequency and higher LMSYS performance across all sampling settings.

直接优势分析. 表9根据同一人口z分数公约,利用各自奖励的转变来重建这两种方法的最终优势。 前2位的差距是每个速率组内最大的优势和第二大的优势之间的差别.
GRGC产生更大的差距,较少靠近联系,更强大的顶端-1和双向保留,表明GRPO最终优势的分离和扰动稳定性更好.
表10还表明,仅靠其他取样并不能解决分散程度低的问题。 在此,批量大小计算每次更新的提示,分组大小计算每个提示,分散度低表示相对std < 0.15 < 0.15 > 。 增加每次更新的提示次数或每次更新的回复次数只能对性别与发展提供有限的改进,而GRGC在所有取样环境中始终保持低低分散频率和高水平的LMSYS性能。

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: We identify a previously overlooked critic-to-advantage mismatch in adversarial black-box distillation: the Bradley–Terry critic optimizes teacher–student discrimination, whereas GRPO depends on the within-group geometry of student rewards. This diagnosis yields a two-stage reward-geometry principle, instantiated by GRGC through source-mean-anchored groupwise OT during critic-side reward formation and order-preserving contrast reshaping before final advantage normalization. Across model pairs, datasets, and evaluation protocols, GRGC produces better separated and more perturbation-stable advantages, improves distillation quality, and adds negligible runtime overhead.
blocks.zh: 在对抗性的黑盒蒸馏中,我们发现一个先前被忽视的批评者与优势的不匹配:布拉德利-特里批评者优化了教师-学生歧视,而GPRO则依赖于学生奖励的几何组别。 这种诊断得出了两阶段的奖励-几何原则,GRGC在评论方奖励形成和保留秩序的对比重塑最终优势正常化之前,通过来源-任选组OT进行即时分析。 跨模型对、数据集和评价协议,GRGC产生更好的分离和更扰动稳定的优势,提高蒸馏质量,并增加可忽略不计的运行时间间接费用。

blocks.en: Appendix B More Related Work
blocks.zh: 附录B

blocks.en: Optimal Transport (OT) provides a principled geometric framework for comparing probability distributions by computing the minimal cost required to transform one distribution into another. Compared to divergences such as KL and Jensen–Shannon, OT remains meaningful even when supports do not overlap and thus yields a more faithful notion of distributional discrepancy [ 55 , 56 ] . The resulting Wasserstein distance has been widely adopted in image generation [ 57 , 58 , 59 ] , causal structure learning and reasoning [ 60 , 61 ] , unsupervised learning [ 62 , 63 , 64 ] , and reinforcement learning [ 65 , 66 , 67 ] . Entropy-regularized OT, or Sinkhorn distance [ 68 ] , further enables scalable OT-based methods in domain adaptation [ 69 , 70 , 71 ] and dataset distillation [ 72 , 73 , 74 , 75 ] .
blocks.zh: 优化运输(OT)通过计算将一种分布转化为另一种分布所需的最低成本,为比较概率分布提供了一个原则几何框架. 与KL和Jensen-Shannon等差异相比,即使支持没有重叠,OT仍然有意义,因此产生了更忠实的分配差异概念[55,56]. 由此产生的Wasserstein距离在图像生成[57,58,59],因果结构学习和推理[60,61],无监督学习[62,63,64],以及强化学习[65,66,67]中被广泛采用. Entropy-rentized OT,或Sinkhorn距离[68],进一步使得在域内适应[69,70,71]和数据集蒸馏[72,73,74,75]中可以采用可扩展的OT方法.

blocks.en: In knowledge distillation, OT has been used to transfer richer structural information than pointwise KL matching [ 76 , 77 ] . WCoRD aligns teacher and student representation distributions with Wasserstein contrastive objectives [ 78 ] ; KNOT distills teacher label distributions for NLP tasks by minimizing OT cost in label space [ 79 ] ; and recent LLM distillation methods use Wasserstein, OT, or cross-tokenizer distribution-matching objectives to handle vocabulary mismatch and multi-level token/sequence alignment [ 30 , 80 , 81 , 32 , 9 ] . These works use distribution matching as a teacher–student knowledge-transfer loss, typically aligning logits, label distributions, hidden representations, or token spaces. Our use of OT is different: GRGC does not align student outputs to teacher logits or representations. Instead, it applies a one-dimensional groupwise OT regularizer to the adversarial critic’s student-side reward group, so that the reward geometry consumed by GRPO has controlled spread, ordered shape, and stable pre-normalization conditioning.
blocks.zh: 在知识蒸馏中,OT被用来传输比点对齐的KL更丰富的结构信息[76,77]. WCORD将师生代表分布与Wasserstein对比目标[78];KNOT通过最小化标签空间的OT成本为NLP任务的教师分馏标签分布[79];以及最近的LLM分馏方法使用Wasserstein,OT,或跨tokenstein配对目标来处理词汇不匹配和多层次的符号/序列配对[30,80,81,32,9]. 这些作品将分布匹配作为师生知识转让损失,通常对齐日志、标签分布、隐藏表达或符号空间。 我们使用OT是不同的:GRGC没有将学生产出与教师的日志或表述一致. 反之,它用一维的组合式OT调节器对对手批评者的学生方奖励组进行,这样GRPO所消耗的奖励几何可以控制扩散,定型,稳定的常态前条件.

blocks.en: Reward shaping has long been used to improve reinforcement-learning optimization by modifying the reward signal while preserving or clarifying the target behavior. Potential-based reward shaping gives policy-invariance guarantees for MDPs [ 82 ] , with later extensions connecting shaping to value initialization [ 83 ] and dynamic shaping functions [ 84 ] . Other classical methods address reward scale and credit assignment: PopArt normalizes value targets across changing reward magnitudes [ 85 ] , while RUDDER redistributes delayed returns to reduce temporal credit-assignment difficulty [ 86 ] . In language-model alignment, preference-based reward learning trains scalar reward models from comparisons [ 87 , 88 , 89 ] , with later work studying reward overoptimization [ 90 ] , implicit reward modeling through DPO [ 91 ] , and reward-model evaluation through RewardBench [ 92 ] . Recent calibration-oriented work further shows that reward-model accuracy and reward-model confidence biases can be misaligned with downstream policy quality [ 93 , 94 ] , proposes post-hoc correction of reward-model biases such as length bias [ 95 ] , and introduces OT-based distributional preference alignment [ 96 ] . These methods mainly study environment-reward transformations, value-target normalization, delayed-return redistribution, fixed/implicit reward models, or distributional alignment between preferred and dispreferred samples. GRGC addresses a different interface: in adversarial black-box distillation, the critic is trained online as a teacher–student discriminator and its student-side scores are immediately consumed by grouped advantage construction. Our calibration therefore targets the prompt-wise geometry of student-only reward groups, including their spread, ordered shape, and margin separability, rather than global reward scale, reward-model accuracy, or preference-distribution dominance alone.
blocks.zh: 长期以来,奖励造型一直被用于通过修改奖励信号,同时保留或澄清目标行为来改进强化学习优化. 基于潜力的奖励塑造为多边发展方案提供了政策变化的保障[82],后来的扩展将塑造与价值初始化[83]和动态塑造函数[84]联系起来。 其他传统方法涉及奖励尺度和信用分配: PopArt在不断变化的奖励规模中使价值目标正常化[85],而RUDDER则重新分配延迟回报以减少时间信用分配困难[86]. 在语言-模型对齐中,基于优待的奖励学习列车从比较[87,88,89]中的奖励模型,后期工作研究奖励过度优化[90],通过DPO的暗示奖励模型[91],通过RewardBench的奖励-模型评价[92]. 最近面向校准的工作进一步表明,奖励模式的准确性和奖励模式的信任偏差可能与下游政策质量错配[93,94],提议对奖励模式偏差如长度偏差等进行事后校正[95],并引入基于OT的分布偏好调整[96]. 这些方法主要研究环境回报转化,价值目标正常化,延迟回报再分配,固定/隐含的奖励模式,或偏好样本和偏好样本之间的分配一致. GRGC针对不同的界面:在对抗性的黑箱蒸馏中,评论家作为教师-学生歧视者在线接受训练,其学生-侧面的分数立即被分组优势构建消耗. 因此,我们的校准目标就是对学生唯一的奖励团体进行迅速的几何,包括他们的分布、定型和比值分隔,而不是全球奖励尺度、奖励模式的准确性,或只以优惠分配为主。

blocks.en: Here we formalize the mechanism behind GRGC across critic training, reward geometry, advantage construction, and grouped policy optimization. To keep the notation aligned with the main method, we distinguish four quantities throughout this section: raw critic rewards r i r_{i} , intermediate standardized grouped scores z i z_{i} , transformed rewards r ^ i \hat{r}_{i} , and final GRPO advantages A i A_{i} . The mechanism we analyze is therefore BT critic objective ⟶ reward geometry of ​ r ⟶ stability of ​ z ⟶ separability of ​ r ^ \displaystyle\text{BT critic objective}\;\longrightarrow\;\text{reward geometry of }r\;\longrightarrow\;\text{stability of }z\;\longrightarrow\;\text{separability of }\hat{r} (14) ⟶ quality of the final advantages ​ A ⟶ policy separation and clipped-surrogate stability . \displaystyle\longrightarrow\;\text{quality of the final advantages }A\;\longrightarrow\;\text{policy separation and clipped-surrogate stability}. This section establishes the complete mechanism chain. We first show that the BT critic objective has an intrinsic fixed-mean bias toward collapsed student reward groups, and then quantify how low dispersion and weak scale make grouped signals fragile. We next show that Gaussian OT calibration controls scale and ordered shape while using the unique optimal translation anchor, after which the signed power transform enlarges already informative margins. Finally, we connect the resulting advantage gaps to one-step policy separation and bound the effect of advantage errors on the clipped GRPO surrogate.

The mismatch is stronger than a missing regularizer: on every fixed-mean slice of student scores, the BT term strictly penalizes mean-preserving dispersion and uniquely favors collapse. This does not claim that unconstrained adversarial training must always collapse, because the teacher score and group mean also evolve. It establishes that the critic objective contains no countervailing within-group preference and instead exerts a structural pressure toward the failure mode diagnosed in Figure 2 .

Proposition 2 formalizes the most direct downstream consequence of low dispersion and weak margins. When a reward group becomes too flat, the smallest useful within-group gap becomes comparable to ordinary critic noise. The result is not merely a cosmetic change in summary statistics: the identity of the better student response can itself become unstable.

Proposition 3 formalizes why unstable or collapsed reward scale directly hurts grouped signal construction. The issue is not simply that some groups have lower variance than others. Rather, once the pre-normalization scale becomes too small, the same raw perturbation produces a much larger change in the standardized grouped signal z z , which is exactly the quantity later consumed by the power transform.

Proposition 4.1 shows that CGC does not merely encourage a larger average variance. It penalizes collapse against a full ordered target geometry with strictly positive spread. This matters because Proposition 3 depends on the actual scale of the reward group consumed by normalization. OT calibration therefore improves the pre-normalization geometry that determines the stability of the downstream grouped signal.

blocks.en: Proposition 4.2 directly answers why CGC is more than variance control. The first term measures scale mismatch, but the second term measures ordered shape mismatch: how the empirical within-group gaps align with the target quantile progression across ranks. A variance-only regularizer can constrain the first term, but it leaves the second completely unconstrained. OT calibration therefore regularizes the full one-dimensional prompt-group geometry rather than only its overall spread.
blocks.zh: 提案4.2直接回答了为什么CGC不仅仅是差异控制. 第一个术语衡量尺度不匹配,但第二个术语衡量尺度命令形状不匹配:各组内部的经验性差距如何与跨等级的目标量级进展相一致。 仅限差异调节器可以约束第一个术语,但让第二个术语完全不受约束. OT校准因此使完整的一维即时群几何规范化,而不仅仅是其整体传播.

blocks.en: Centering the reference at the current student group mean is therefore the unique least-cost translation of any prescribed centered geometry, rather than a heuristic anchor. It also makes CGC insensitive to an arbitrary common offset in critic scores. If the teacher and student critic scores are shifted together, the BT score differences are unchanged and Proposition 4.3 shows that the CGC term is unchanged as well; the combined critic objective can therefore regulate within-group geometry without imposing an absolute score origin.
blocks.zh: 因此,在目前学生群体中集中参考,是任何规定中心几何的独特成本最低的翻译,而不是一个热力锚。 这也使得CGC对评论分数中任意常见的抵消不敏感. 如果老师和学生评论家的分数一起转移,BT分数差异不变,Proposition 4.3显示CGC名词也不变;因此综合评论家目标可以调节组内几何,而不会强制要求绝对分数来源.

blocks.en: The Gaussian target is best understood as a canonical member of a broader ordered location-scale family. More generally, one could use any ordered location-scale family t ~ j = μ x + s ​ ψ j , ψ 1 ≤ ⋯ ≤ ψ N . \tilde{t}_{j}=\mu_{x}+s\,\psi_{j},\qquad\psi_{1}\leq\cdots\leq\psi_{N}. (59) The relevant question is which family best satisfies the structural requirements imposed by grouped advantage construction. We require four properties: • non-degenerate spread, so collapse is penalized; • symmetry, so neither tail is privileged a priori; • smooth rank progression, so adjacent target gaps change gradually rather than abruptly; • single-parameter scale control, so the overall conditioning strength is easy to tune. These desiderata are necessary but not sufficient to identify a unique target: other symmetric location-scale families, including logistic quantiles, also provide closed-form, non-degenerate, single-scale templates. The key distinction is therefore the induced rank-gap profile. We use the Gaussian target because it provides a moderate interior-to-tail progression: less rigid than constant linear spacing, but less tail-aggressive than heavier-tailed alternatives such as Laplace or logistic. In this sense, the Gaussian target is used as a canonical conditioning prior for grouped optimization geometry, not as a claim about the true semantic distribution of teacher preference.

Proposition 5 moves the power-transform analysis beyond simple monotonicity. Once critic-side calibration has produced a group whose standardized scores have already exited the near-tie regime, group power increases the usable separation of those scores for advantage construction. This is exactly the quantity grouped optimization needs: not arbitrary rescaling, but stronger separation among already informative candidates.

This proposition clarifies the role of PGM. Once CGC has moved a prompt group into a regime where standardized margins are already informative, PGM preserves those rankings and enlarges the usable separation further. This makes the transformed reward signal r ^ \hat{r} more decisive for final advantage construction; the resulting optimization benefit is then supported by the grouped-surrogate analysis below and the main experiments.

Proposition 7 links final advantage quality to a policy-level quantity in the grouped softmax surrogate. Pairwise policy separation after one grouped update is controlled by the corresponding pairwise advantage gap. Larger and more reliable final advantage gaps therefore produce larger and more reliable one-step separation toward the candidate assigned higher advantage in this surrogate model.

blocks.en: Proposition 9 gives an objective-level link between advantage quality and the actual clipped GRPO surrogate used for policy optimization. It shows that distorted advantages do not merely affect a ranking diagnostic: they perturb the clipped surrogate itself by an amount proportional to the advantage error. Because GRPO constructs group-centered advantages, the sharper preservation bound applies directly to our setting, and the same argument extends to minibatches by averaging over prompt groups. Thus, the preceding geometry results matter because CGC and PGM reduce the sources of advantage distortion that enter the real policy objective.
blocks.zh: 提案9给出了优势质量与实际剪辑的用于政策优化的GRPO替代物之间的客观层面联系. 它表明扭曲的优势并不仅仅影响排名诊断:它们以与优势误差成比例的金额搅乱被剪切的代孕本身. 由于GPRO构建了以群体为中心的优势,更锐利的保存约束直接适用于我们的设定,同样的论点也通过平均超过迅速的组合而延伸到了小batches. 因此,前几何结果很重要,因为CGC和PGM减少了进入实际政策目标的优势扭曲来源.

blocks.en: The two modules optimize successive links in the same mechanism. Proposition 1 identifies the BT objective’s fixed-mean collapse bias, while Propositions 2 and 3 quantify the resulting ranking fragility and normalization sensitivity. CGC counteracts this source-side failure: Propositions 4.1–4.3 establish non-collapse, ordered-shape control, optimal anchoring, and common-shift invariance. PGM then acts on the conditioned grouped signal: Propositions 5–8 show that it preserves ordering, enlarges informative separation, and translates advantage gaps into correctly directed one-step policy movement. Proposition 9 further shows that advantage errors induce bounded distortion of the clipped GRPO surrogate. Together, these results formalize the full chain from critic-objective bias to reward geometry, advantage quality, and the policy objective; Figure 2 and the main ablations corroborate its optimization-level consequences.
blocks.zh: 这两个模块在同一机制中优化了连续链接。 提案1确定了BT目标的固定-平均崩溃偏差,而提案2和3则量化了由此产生的排名脆弱性和正常化敏感性. CGC抵消了这种源边故障:建议4.1-4.3建立非碰撞、有序形状控制、最佳锚定和常见的易变。 PGM然后在附带条件的分组信号上行事: 提案5-8表明,它保留了订单,扩大了信息分离,并将优势差距转化为正确指导的一步政策运动。 提议9进一步表明,优势错误会诱发被剪切的GRPO代孕的定界扭曲. 这些结果使从批评者客观偏见到奖励几何、优势质量和政策目标的整个链条正规化; 图2和主要事件证实了其优化层面的后果。

Proposition 10 makes precise why Gaussian is a better conditioning prior than either linear spacing or heavier-tailed alternatives. Linear targets are too rigid: they enforce the same gap everywhere and cannot distinguish central ambiguity from extreme ranks. Laplace and logistic are too tail-aggressive: they allocate an increasingly large share of the total separation budget to the extremes. Gaussian lies in the middle. It preserves nontrivial rank variation and smooth interior-to-tail progression without over-concentrating separation in the tails. This is exactly the geometry needed for conditioning rather than aggressive sharpening.
blocks.zh: 10号提案精确地说明了为什么高斯琴比线性间隔或更重尾巴的替代品更适合使用。 线性目标过于僵硬:它们到处执行同样的差距,无法区分中心模糊度和极端级别. 地点和后勤过于落后:它们将离职总预算中越来越多的份额分配给极端。 高斯安在中间. 它保留了非三角级的分级变化和平滑的内向尾进动,而尾部没有过度集中的分离. 这恰恰是调节所需要的几何学,而不是侵略性的磨削.

blocks.en: The Gaussian quantile template satisfies these basic requirements, but these requirements alone do not make it unique. Logistic and Laplace quantiles are also symmetric, non-degenerate, closed-form, and single-scale. The deciding factor is the rank-gap profile formalized in Proposition 10. Linear spacing is too flat because it assigns the same gap to every rank pair; Laplace and logistic are too tail-aggressive because their quantile gaps grow at rate Θ ⁡ ( ( 1 − p ) − 1 ) \Theta((1-p)^{-1}) near the extremes. Gaussian quantiles change smoothly with rank while using a milder tail expansion, so they provide a balanced conditioning geometry: central candidates remain moderately separated, tails receive additional but not excessive spacing, and the template keeps a controlled scale.
blocks.zh: 高斯四重奏模板满足了这些基本要求,但这些要求本身并不能使它独具特色. 逻辑学和拉普勒斯方块也是对称的,不脱落的,封闭的形态的,和单比例的. 决定因素是建议10中正式确定的军衔差距。 线性间距太平,因为它为每个等级配对分配相同的空隙; 拉普拉斯和逻辑性太差,因为它们的四进制间距以接近极点的 = ((1 - p) − 1)\ Theta ((1-p) → 1) 速度增长。 高斯四位数在使用较温和的尾部膨胀时随级别而平稳变化,因此它们提供了平衡的调节几何:中心候选人保持中度分离,尾部得到额外但不会过长的间隔,模板保持一个控制尺度.

blocks.en: A uniform-quantile target would also prevent collapse, but it imposes constant spacing across the entire group. This creates a geometry with no distinction between central ambiguity and extreme ranks. In contrast, our diagnosis suggests that many groups contain several near-tied middle candidates together with a few more separated extremes; a Gaussian template accommodates this more naturally. Heavy-tailed priors such as Laplace or logistic are also possible and satisfy many of the same basic desiderata, but they allocate relatively more of the separation budget to extreme quantiles. Since our critic-side objective is meant to improve conditioning rather than aggressively enlarge extremes, the Gaussian prior is a better default because its tail progression sits between the overly rigid linear template and the heavier-tailed alternatives.
blocks.zh: 统一量化的目标也能够防止崩塌,但它会对整个群体造成恒定间隔。 这创造了一个几何,不分中心模糊度和极端等级. 相比之下,我们的诊断表明,许多群体中包含几个近乎紧密的中间候选人,还有几个更分离的极端;一个高斯模板更自然地容纳了这一点. 拉普拉斯或物流等重尾前科也是可能的,满足了许多相同的基本底线,但它们将相对更多的分离预算分配给极端的四分位数. 由于我们的批评者-侧面的目标是改善条件,而不是大力扩大极端,因此高斯之前的默认更好,因为它的尾部进化介于过于僵硬的线性模板和较重的尾端替代品之间。

blocks.en: The critic-side OT term constrains the ordered geometry of each prompt group, not just a few aggregate statistics. Simpler penalties such as variance regularization, moment matching, or entropy-style smoothing could encourage a broader spread on average, but they would still leave many rank configurations admissible. In contrast, the OT loss ties each ordered score r ( j ) r_{(j)} to an ordered reference quantile t j t_{j} , so it simultaneously constrains collapse, tail imbalance, and the progression of gaps across ranks. This is the key distinction from generic reward normalization or scalar variance control: CGC regularizes the full one-dimensional prompt-group shape that will later be consumed by grouped optimization.
blocks.zh: 评论家-侧式OT名词限制每个提示组的有序几何,而不仅仅是几个汇总统计. 更简单的处罚,如差异正规化,瞬间匹配,或 en式平滑等,可以鼓励平均更广泛的分布,但它们仍然会留下许多等级配置可以被接受. 相比之下,OT损失与每个命令的得分 r(j) r(j)} 与一个命令的参考量表 t j(j)}的关联,因此它同时制约了崩溃,尾部失衡,以及各个级别间差距的发展. 这是与通用奖励正常化或控制尺度差异的关键区别: CGC将日后通过分组优化消耗的完整的一维即时组形状规范化.

blocks.en: The Gaussian target is therefore not used as a distributional assumption on semantic rewards. It is used as a group-centered ordered template whose gap profile sits between constant linear spacing and heavy-tailed alternatives. The important distinction is not that Gaussian is the only closed-form symmetric single-scale option, but that it provides the most suitable conditioning profile among the tested options: non-degenerate spread, symmetric treatment of ranks, smooth gap progression, and moderate rather than excessive tail expansion.
blocks.zh: 因此,高斯目标不被用作语义奖励的分布假设. 它被用作一个以组为主的定点模板,其空隙剖面分布在恒定线性间隔和重尾的替代品之间. 重要的区别不在于高斯琴是唯一的封闭式对称单级选项,而是在被测试的选项中提供了最合适的条件配置:非变质散射,排位对称的处理,平滑的间隙进化,以及中等而非过度的尾部扩张.

blocks.en: C.2 Why group_power Among Alternative Reward Transforms
blocks.zh: C.2 联合国 为何在替代奖励变换中的群力

blocks.en: Our implementation contains several reward-transform alternatives, including global transforms ( linear , linear_fixed , beta , beta_logit , temperature ), group-aware standardization-only transforms ( group_zscore ), stronger nonlinear transforms ( group_sinh ), sparse winner-focused transforms ( top1_margin_boost ), and rank-replacement transforms ( rank_gaussian ). The comparison is organized around the structural requirements of pre-GRPO advantage construction: the transform should be prompt-group aware, preserve critic ordering, retain magnitude information, and provide controlled gain to informative margins.
blocks.zh: 我们的实施包含几个奖励转换的替代方案,包括全局变换(线性,线性_固定,β,β_logit,温度),群体意识标准化的仅限变换(group_zscore),更强的非线性变换(group_sinh),少部分赢家重点变换(top1_margin_boost),以及军衔更换变换(quad_gaussian). 比较是围绕GRPO之前的优势构建的结构要求安排的:转型过程应迅速群策群力,保持批评者订购,保留规模信息,并提供可控收益以达到信息边际.

blocks.en: The failures we target are groupwise: low dispersion, weak top-group margins, and unstable within-group scale. Global transforms apply the same scalar map to all samples regardless of prompt-group membership. They can rescale the critic output globally, but they do not directly repair a nearly tied group or strengthen margins relative to that group’s own scale. As a result, they are mismatched to the grouped nature of the optimization problem.
blocks.zh: 我们的目标失败是分组:分散度低,顶组边距弱,组内尺度不稳定。 全球变换对所有样本都采用相同的标尺图,而不论即时组成员. 他们可以在全球范围调整批评者的产出,但并不直接修复一个几乎捆绑的团体,也不加强相对于该团体自身规模的边际。 因此,它们与优化问题的分组性质不匹配。

blocks.en: group_zscore removes within-group shift and scale, but it does not further separate ambiguous candidates. After critic-side OT calibration, this can still leave grouped margins too weak for efficient policy updates. In other words, group_zscore improves comparability but not decisiveness.
blocks.zh: group_zscore去除组内移位和规模,但不会进一步分离模棱两可的候选人. 在批评方OT校准后,这仍可能使分组差值太弱,无法有效地更新政策。 换句话说,group_zscore可以提高可比性,但不能提高决定性.

blocks.en: group_sinh is group-aware and monotone, but its tails grow exponentially, which makes it more sensitive to moderately large spurious standardized scores. top1_margin_boost is highly local: it only changes the group winner and tends to create a winner-take-all geometry rather than improving the whole reward group. CDF remapping and rank_gaussian both replace much of the original magnitude structure with quantile position; this preserves rank, but it weakens the critic’s own margin information.
blocks.zh: group_sinh是组意识和单调的,但其尾部呈指数增长,这使其对中等大假的标准化分数更加敏感. top1_margin_boost是高度本地化的:它只改变组胜方,倾向于创建一个胜方-全取几何,而不是改进整个奖励组. CDF重映图和排名_gausian都用四级位置取代了最初的星级结构;这保留了排名,但削弱了批评者自己的差值信息.

blocks.en: The transform r ^ i = sign ⁡ ( z i ) ​ | z i | γ \hat{r}_{i}=\mathrm{sign}(z_{i})|z_{i}|^{\gamma} (104) has four properties that are jointly important in our setting: • it is group-aware , because it operates on per-group standardized scores; • it is order-preserving , because it is strictly monotone in z i z_{i} ; • it is margin-amplifying , because deviations farther from the group center receive larger polynomial local gain; • it is less destructive than rank replacement and typically less brittle than exponential tails. Thus, among the available alternatives, group_power provides the most suitable compromise between preserving critic-implied ordering, sharpening already informative grouped margins, and avoiding the magnitude loss induced by quantile remapping or the overly sharp tails induced by stronger nonlinear transforms.

Proposition 11 explains why group power is not an arbitrary monotone map. If we require the transform to preserve critic ordering, treat positive and negative standardized deviations symmetrically, avoid extra shape parameters, and apply a scale-consistent power-law gain to informative margins, then the signed power form is forced. The compared alternatives violate at least one of these requirements: rank-Gaussian and CDF remapping replace magnitude information with quantile position, top-1 boosting is not a pointwise transform on the whole group, and sinh \sinh is not homogeneous and has exponentially growing local gain. This is why group power is the appropriate PGM transform for advantage construction.
blocks.zh: 11号提案解释了为什么团体力量不是任意的单调图. 如果我们要求变换来保持评论家的顺序,对称地对待正负的标准化偏差,避免额外的形状参数,并将一个符合比例的功率法收益应用到信息边际,那么签名的功率表就强制了. 比较的替代品至少违反了其中的一项要求:分级-Gausian和CDF重映图用四分位取代量级信息,顶-1助推并不是整个组群的点心转变,sinh\sinh不均匀,并指数增长当地收益. 这就是为什么集团动力是合适的PGM转换,用于优势构建.

blocks.en: The two modules act on different failure modes and therefore should not be viewed as interchangeable reward shaping steps. CGC first reduces under-dispersion and scale inconsistency in the raw critic rewards { r i } \{r_{i}\} , which makes grouped normalization better conditioned but does not by itself impose a magnitude-dependent gain on already informative standardized gaps. PGM then acts on the standardized grouped structure that remains: it preserves ordering while enlarging non-near-zero gaps in the signal used to construct final advantages. Put differently, CGC improves the input conditioning of grouped optimization, whereas PGM improves the separability of the signal consumed after that conditioning step. This division of labor is why the full method is stronger than either component alone in Table 6 .
blocks.zh: 这两个单元针对不同的失败模式,因此不应被视为可互换的奖励塑造步骤。 CGC首先减少原始评论者奖 { r i } 中分布不足和比例不一致的现象, 这使得分组正常化的条件更好, 然后,PGM就剩下的标准化分组结构采取行动:它保持顺序,同时扩大用于构建最终优势的信号的非近零差距。 换句话说,CGC改进了组合优化的输入条件,而PGM则改进了该调节步骤后所消耗的信号的分离性. 这种分工是为什么整个方法比表6中的任何一个部分都强。

blocks.en: We use greedy decoding and set the maximum response length to 1536 tokens, except for the Doubao-Seed-2.0 LMSYS setting where responses are capped at 2048 tokens as described in the implementation details. Prompts are constructed using the same prompt wrapper as MiniLLM [ 11 ] and GAD [ 18 ] , which is illustrated in Figure 5 and Figure 6 . For evaluation with Qwen2.5-72B feedback, we first use Qwen2.5-72B to generate a reference answer for each instruction using the prompt in Figure 5 . We then present the student response and the corresponding Qwen2.5-72B reference answer to the judge model, which evaluates both responses using the prompt shown in Figure 6 .
blocks.zh: 我们使用贪婪的解码,将最大响应长度设定为1536个令牌,但杜宝-种子-2.0 LMSYS设定的响应上限为2048个令牌,如执行细节所述. 用与MiniLLM [11] 和GAD [18] 相同的即时包装器构造提示,如图5和图6所示。 对于带有Quen2.5-72B反馈的评价,我们首先使用Quen2.5-72B,使用图5中的提示来生成每个指令的参考答案. 然后,我们将学生的反应和相应的Qwen2.5-72B参考答复提交给法官模型,该模型利用图6所示的提示来评价两个答复。

blocks.en: The judge assigns one scalar score to the student response and one scalar score to the reference response. The reported automatic evaluation score is computed as Score = StudentScore StudentScore + RefScore , \mathrm{Score}=\frac{\mathrm{StudentScore}}{\mathrm{StudentScore}+\mathrm{RefScore}}, (110) where StudentScore \mathrm{StudentScore} denotes the judge score assigned to the student output and RefScore \mathrm{RefScore} denotes the judge score assigned to the paired reference answer. This normalized score lies in ( 0 , 1 ) (0,1) and measures the quality of the student response relative to the reference answer. In the reported experimental metrics, we report 100 × Score 100\times\mathrm{Score} , so the automatic evaluation results are presented on a 0 0 to 100 100 scale.
blocks.zh: 裁判为学生响应分配1分,为参考响应分配1分. 报告的自动评价分数计算为:Score = StudentScore StudentScore + RefScore,\mathrm{分数}\mathrm{分数}\mathrm{分数} 学生分数{ mathrm{分数} (110) 表示分配给学生输出的法官分数和RefScore\mathrm{ refScore} 表示分配给对等参考答案的法官分数. 这一常态分数在于(0, 1) (0, 1),并相对于参考答案衡量学生响应的质量. 在报告的实验度量衡中,我们报告100×分数100\times\mathrm{Score},所以自动评价的结果以0到100的尺度呈现.

blocks.en: In addition to the averaged score, we also report win rate when appropriate. For a given evaluation set, a sample is counted as a win if the judge assigns a strictly higher scalar score to the student response than to the reference response, a loss if the student score is strictly lower, and a tie otherwise. The win rate is then defined as WinRate = # { StudentScore > RefScore } # ​ { all evaluated samples } . \mathrm{WinRate}=\frac{\#\{\mathrm{StudentScore}>\mathrm{RefScore}\}}{\#}\{\text{all evaluated samples}\}. (111) Thus, win rate measures the fraction of evaluation prompts on which the student is preferred to the reference answer under the same judge, while the averaged score reflects the relative quality margin after normalization.
blocks.zh: 除了平均得分之外,我们还酌情报告得分率。 对于一个给定的评价集,如果法官给学生的回答分配的分数严格高于参考答复,如果学生的分数严格较低,则将样本算作胜负;如果给学生的回答分数严格较低,则将损失计为胜负,否则则比对. 然后将胜率定义为WinRate = # {学生分数 > RefScore } # {所有评价样本}. 校对:Soup 因此,中和率衡量评价中学生比同一法官的参考答案更受青睐的部分,而平均得分则反映正常化后的相对质量差值。

blocks.en: G.1 Sensitivity Analysis
blocks.zh: G.1 敏感性分析

blocks.en: GRGC requires tuning only two method-specific hyperparameters beyond the underlying GAD training recipe: the critic-side OT weight λ OT \lambda_{\mathrm{OT}} and the policy-side power exponent γ \gamma . The Gaussian reference uses unit-scale quantiles throughout our experiments. We therefore focus the sensitivity study on λ OT \lambda_{\mathrm{OT}} and γ \gamma . As shown in Table 12 and Table 13 , the method is stable across a reasonably broad range, which is important in practice because it means GRGC does not require delicate tuning to outperform baseline GAD.
blocks.zh: GRGC只需要调制两个方法上特有的超参数, 高斯的参考文献 在我们的实验中 使用单位级的四分位数 因此,我们把敏感度研究的重点放在 OT\lambda\ mathrm{OT}和 γ\gamma上。 如表12和表13所示,该方法在相当广泛的范围内是稳定的,这在实践中很重要,因为它意味着全球资源变化图不需要进行微妙的调整,以达到超过基准的性别分布图。

blocks.en: Table 12 studies the OT weight λ OT \lambda_{\mathrm{OT}} . When λ OT \lambda_{\mathrm{OT}} is too small, the critic-side geometry constraint becomes weak and the method moves toward a lightly regularized GAD regime, so under-dispersion and unstable reward scale are only partially corrected. When λ OT \lambda_{\mathrm{OT}} is too large, the critic becomes overly conservative and policy improvement slows down because the reward geometry is over-regularized. Between these two extremes, however, performance is very stable: values from roughly 0.005 0.005 to 0.05 0.05 give nearly identical results, and we therefore adopt λ OT = 0.01 \lambda_{\mathrm{OT}}=0.01 as a simple default.
blocks.zh: 表12研究了OT的重量。 当 OT\lambda\ mathrm{ OT} 过小时, 批评方几何限制变得薄弱, 方法走向轻度规范化的 GAD 制度, 当 OT\lambda\ mathrm{ OT} 过于庞大时, 批评者变得过于保守, 然而,在这两个极端之间,性能非常稳定:从大约0.005 0.005到0.05 0.05的数值给出了几乎相同的结果,因此我们采用 λ OT = 0.01\lambda _{\ mathrm{ OT}}=0.01 作为简单的默认.

blocks.en: Table 13 studies the power exponent γ \gamma . When γ \gamma is too close to 1 1 , the transform degenerates toward a near-identity mapping, so the GRPO-side shaping effect becomes weak and only part of the grouped-margin problem is recovered. When γ \gamma is too large, the transformed rewards become overly sharp and the grouped optimization signal becomes less robust. Again, a broad intermediate region remains stable, with values from about 1.2 1.2 to 1.6 1.6 producing very similar results. For convenience, we use γ = 1.5 \gamma=1.5 throughout the paper.
blocks.zh: 表13研究了动力激发器 γ\gamma。 当γ\gamma太接近11时,变换会退化成近身份映射,因此GRPO侧面的塑造效果变得很弱,只有集合边际问题的一部分被恢复. 当 γ\gamma 太大时,转换后的奖励变得过于尖锐,分组优化信号变得不那么强健. 同样,一个广泛的中间区域保持稳定,数值从1.2到1.61.6,结果非常相似。 为方便起见,我们在整个论文中使用γ=1.5\gamma=1.5。

blocks.en: Overall, these results show that GRGC is easy to tune in practice: only two intuitive parameters are tuned, both admit stable operating ranges rather than narrow optima, and the default choices ( λ OT = 0.01 , γ = 1.5 ) (\lambda_{\mathrm{OT}}=0.01,\gamma=1.5) work well across model scales. This makes the method convenient to deploy in practical black-box distillation settings.
blocks.zh: 总体而言,这些结果表明GRGC在实践中容易调谐:只有两个直观参数被调谐,两者都承认稳定的操作范围而不是狭义的Ottima,默认选择(QQ OT = 0.01, γ = 1.5) (\lambda _{\mathrm{OT}}=0.01,\gamma = 1.5)在模型尺度上效果良好. 这使得在实用的黑盒蒸馏设置中部署的方法变得方便.

blocks.en: Table 12: Sensitivity to the critic-side OT weight λ OT \lambda_{\mathrm{OT}} . Results are averaged Qwen2.5-72B evaluation scores. Very small λ OT \lambda_{\mathrm{OT}} weakens geometry conditioning, while overly large λ OT \lambda_{\mathrm{OT}} makes the critic too conservative. A broad middle range remains stable, and we use λ OT = 0.01 \lambda_{\mathrm{OT}}=0.01 in the main experiments.
blocks.zh: 表12:对评论方OT重量的敏感度 OT\lambda\mathrm{OT}. 结果平均为Quen2.5-72B评价分数。 非常小的 OT\lambda\ mathrm{OT} 削弱了几何条件,而过大的 OT\lambda\ mathrm{OT} 让批评者过于保守。 广义的中间范围仍然稳定,我们在主要实验中使用了QQ OT=0.01\lambda_{\mathrm{OT}}=0.01.

blocks.en: Table 13: Sensitivity to the power exponent γ \gamma . Results are averaged Qwen2.5-72B evaluation scores. Values too close to 1 1 reduce the shaping effect, whereas overly large values lead to overly sharp grouped rewards. A broad intermediate region is stable, and we use γ = 1.5 \gamma=1.5 in the main experiments.
blocks.zh: 表13:对动力的敏感度 结果平均为Quen2.5-72B评价分数。 价值太接近11,减少了塑造效果,而价值过高则导致过于尖锐的分组奖励。 一个广义的中间区域是稳定的,我们在主要实验中使用γ=1.5\γ=1.5.

blocks.en: G.2 Distillation with an Explicit Step-by-Step Teacher Instruction
blocks.zh: G.2 明确分步教学的消化

blocks.en: We additionally evaluate our framework in a more challenging Doubao-Seed-2.0 teacher setting by adding an explicit “think step by step” instruction to the input prompt. Doubao-Seed-2.0 uses thinking mode in both this setting and the standard setting; the difference here is the additional prompt instruction. This modification encourages the teacher to produce longer and more structured responses, making the resulting supervision more demanding than standard concise instruction-following outputs. Table 14 summarizes the results. Compared with the standard Doubao-Seed-2.0 teacher responses in Table 4 , the step-by-step teacher achieves higher win rates against the reference answers on LMSYS, Dolly, and SelfInst, increasing from 82.5 % / 75.8 % / 74.0 % 82.5\%/75.8\%/74.0\% to 83.1 % / 82.4 % / 86.4 % 83.1\%/82.4\%/86.4\% , while remaining equally strong on Vicuna at 93.8 % 93.8\% .
blocks.zh: 我们还在更具有挑战性的Doubao-Seed-2.0教师设置中评估我们的框架,在投入提示中增加一个明确的“一步步思考”指示。 Doubao-Seed-2.0在此设置和标准设置中同时使用思维模式;这里的区别是附加的即时指令. 这一修改鼓励教师作出更长期、更有条理的反应,使由此产生的监督比标准的简明教学产出更严格。 表14总结了结果。 与表4中标准的Doubao-Seed-2.0教师回复相比,分步骤教师在LMSYS、Dolly和SelfInst的参考回复中取得了较高的胜率,从82.5%/75.8%/74.0%增至82.5%/75.8/74.0%/83.1%/82.4%/86.1/82.4/86.4=86.4=%,而维库纳的胜率则保持在93.8%/93.8=%。

blocks.en: The student results show that this stronger teacher behavior is also transferred more effectively. This indicates that when the teacher provides higher-quality and more structured answers, GRGC can better translate the richer supervision into stronger student responses by improving the grouped reward signal used for policy optimization.
blocks.zh: 学生的结果显示,这种更强烈的教师行为也被更有效地转移. 这表明,当教师提供质量更高,结构更合理的答案时,GRGC可以通过改进用于政策优化的分组奖励信号,更好地将更丰富的监管转化为更强大的学生回应.

blocks.en: Methodologically, this setting is useful because it enlarges the gap between simple sequence imitation and on-policy optimization from grouped rewards. When teacher answers become longer and structurally richer, merely copying surface form becomes less sufficient, and the quality of grouped reward signals becomes more important. The step-by-step teacher experiments therefore provide an additional stress test showing that GRGC remains effective when the teacher is encouraged to produce richer reasoning-style supervision.
blocks.zh: 从方法上讲,这种设置是有用的,因为它扩大了简单的序列仿制与分组奖励政策优化之间的差距。 当教师的回答变得更长,结构更加丰富时,仅仅复制表面形式就变得不够,分组奖励信号的质量也变得更加重要. 因此,逐步的教师实验提供了额外的压力测试,表明在鼓励教师进行更丰富的推理式监督时,GRGC仍然有效.

blocks.en: Table 14: Automatic evaluation results for models distilled from Doubao-Seed-2.0 with an explicit step-by-step instruction and trained on the Dolly training set. We report the averaged Qwen2.5-72B evaluation score on the test datasets.
blocks.zh: 表14:从Doubao-Seed-2.0中提炼出来的模型的自动评价结果,并附有明确的分步指示和关于Dolly培训集的培训。 我们报告测试数据集的平均Qwen2.5-72B评价分数。

blocks.en: G.3 Human Evaluation Results
blocks.zh: G.3 人类评价结果

blocks.en: Figure 7: Human evaluation results on test sets. We compare GRGC to the models fine-tuned with SeqKD [ 22 ] and GAD [ 18 ] .
blocks.zh: 图7:测试组的人类评价结果。 我们比较了GRGC与SeqKD[22]和GAD[18]的微调模型.

blocks.en: Automatic metrics are useful but incomplete, so we additionally conduct a human study. We engage 10 professional volunteers for annotation. For each evaluated model, each volunteer judges 50 prompt-response groups, ensuring a balanced evaluation set that covers all four test sources used in the paper: 20 groups from the LMSYS test set, 10 from Dolly, 10 from SelfInst, and 10 from Vicuna. All annotators evaluate the same set of prompt-response groups and compare the candidate responses under the same prompt, selecting the better answer based on overall helpfulness, relevance, correctness, and completeness.
blocks.zh: 自动度量衡是有用的,但不完整,所以我们还要进行一项人类研究。 我们请10名专业志愿者做笔记。 对于每个被评价的模型,每个志愿人员评为50个即时反应小组,确保一套均衡的评价,涵盖文件中所用的所有四个测试来源:20组来自LMSYS测试单元,10组来自Dolly,10组来自SelfInst,10组来自Vicuna。 所有注释者都对同一组迅速反应小组进行评价,并在同一迅速反应下比较候选人的答复,根据整体的帮助、相关性、正确性和完整性选择更好的答案。

blocks.en: The annotators are shown the prompt together with the candidate responses and are asked to make a preference judgment using the same criteria throughout the study. The human study only involves expert evaluation of model outputs and does not collect personal or sensitive user information; no separate crowdsourcing platform is used.
blocks.zh: 批注者与候选人的答复一并显示,并请他们在整个研究中采用同样的标准作出优先判断。 人的研究只涉及专家对模型输出的评价,不收集个人或敏感的用户信息;没有使用单独的众包平台.

blocks.en: Figure 7 shows that GRGC is preferred over both SeqKD and GAD in human comparison. This result is important because it confirms that the gains of GRGC are not limited to judge-model scores or response-format differences. Instead, the improvements induced by reward-geometry conditioning are visible to human evaluators as better overall answer quality.
blocks.zh: 图7显示,在人类比较中,GRGC优于SeqKD和GAD。 这一结果很重要,因为它证实GRGC的收益并不限于判断模型分数或响应格式的差异. 相反,人类评价人员可以看到奖励-几何条件带来的改进,认为总体答案质量更好。

blocks.en: G.4 More Visualization Analysis
blocks.zh: G.4 更多可视化 分析

blocks.en: Figure 8: Collapsed prompt groups during training. GRGC keeps the fraction with relative reward std below 0.15 0.15 consistently lower than GAD. Figure 9: Weak-margin groups during training. GRGC reduces the fraction whose normalized top-2 gap is below 0.08 0.08 .
blocks.zh: 图8:培训期间折叠的快速小组。 GRGC将相对奖励的分数保持在0.15 0.15以下,始终低于性别与发展。 图 9:训练期间的弱边际群体. GRGC减少了正常的顶-2差距低于0.080.08的分数.

blocks.en: Figure 8: Collapsed prompt groups during training. GRGC keeps the fraction with relative reward std below 0.15 0.15 consistently lower than GAD.
blocks.zh: 图8:培训期间折叠的快速小组。 GRGC将相对奖励的分数保持在0.15 0.15以下,始终低于性别与发展。

blocks.en: Figure 9: Weak-margin groups during training. GRGC reduces the fraction whose normalized top-2 gap is below 0.08 0.08 .
blocks.zh: 图9:培训期间的弱势群体。 GRGC减少了正常的顶-2差距低于0.080.08的分数.

blocks.en: Figure 10: Unnormalized prompt-group reward spread . The solid lines show the mean prompt-group reward standard deviation, and shaded regions show the 10th–90th percentile range across prompt groups at each step. GRGC keeps the absolute reward spread in a more controlled range than GAD, confirming that the relative-spread improvement is not caused only by normalization with the global reward scale.
blocks.zh: 图10:不合常态的即时组奖励分布. 坚固的线条显示平均的即时组奖励标准偏差,而阴影区域则显示每一步第10-90百分位的即时组范围. GRGC将绝对奖励的分布范围控制在比GAD更强的范围内,证实相对扩展的改进不仅仅是与全球奖励尺度的正常化造成的.

blocks.en: Figure 8 and Figure 9 provide a more direct visualization of the geometric changes induced by GRGC. Here, a collapsed prompt group means that the reward spread within a prompt-wise group is too small, so the candidate responses become poorly separated by the critic; concretely, we mark a group as collapsed when its relative reward standard deviation satisfies rel ​ _ ​ std < 0.15 \mathrm{rel\_std}<0.15 , and the reported collapse ratio is the fraction of such groups in a training window. A weak-margin group means that the top candidates remain too close even after grouping. We define the top-2 margin as the reward difference between the highest-scored and second-highest-scored student responses within the same prompt group, and normalize it by the full within-group reward span to obtain top1 ​ _ ​ top2 ​ _ ​ gap ​ _ ​ ratio \mathrm{top1\_top2\_gap\_ratio} . Concretely, we mark a group as weak-margin when top1 ​ _ ​ top2 ​ _ ​ gap ​ _ ​ ratio < 0.08 \mathrm{top1\_top2\_gap\_ratio}<0.08 , and the reported weak-margin ratio is the fraction of prompt groups with such insufficient top-2 separation.
blocks.zh: 图8和图9对GRGC引发的几何变化提供了更直接的可视化. 在这里,一个崩溃的快速组意味着在快速组内部的悬赏分布太小,因此候选人的回答被批评者忽略了;具体来说,当一个组的相对悬赏标准偏差满足了rel_std < 0.15\mathrm{rel\_std}<0.15,所报道的悬赏比例是训练窗口中这类组的一小部分时,我们标记为崩溃. 一个弱边际群体意味着,即使分组后,顶级候选人仍然过于接近. 我们定义前2级比值为同一快速组内最高分数和第二高分数的学生响应的奖励差数,并通过全组内奖励间距实现正常化,以获得前1_前2_差距_比例\mathrm{top1}\top2}\gap{atio}。 具体地说,当上1 _ 上2 _ 差距_ 比率 < 0.08\ mathrm{ top1}\ top2\\ gap\ rattio > 0.08 时,我们将一个群体标记为弱边距, 所报告的弱边距比例是上2 分离不足的快速群体的一小部分。

blocks.en: Under these definitions, Figure 8 shows that our method suppresses collapsed prompt groups throughout the training window, rather than only improving a single summary statistic at the end of training. Figure 10 complements the relative-spread plot by showing that the unnormalized prompt-group reward standard deviation is also kept in a more controlled range under GRGC, so the effect is not simply produced by dividing by the global reward scale. Figure 9 further shows that this improvement is accompanied by a lower proportion of weak-margin groups in the reward signal eventually consumed by grouped optimization. Taken together, these visualizations support the intended division of labor between the two components of GRGC: critic-side OT calibration reduces group collapse, while policy-side reward shaping makes the remaining grouped margins more usable for GRPO.
blocks.zh: 根据这些定义,图8显示,我们的方法抑制了整个培训窗口的快速群体,而不是仅仅改进培训结束时的单一汇总统计。 图10通过显示未规范的即时群奖励标准偏差也保存在GRGC更受控制的范围内,从而补充了相对广博的情节,因此效果不是简单地通过除以全球奖励尺度来产生. 图9还显示,随着这种改进,在最终通过分组优化而消耗的奖励信号中,弱边际群体的比例较低。 综合起来,这些可视化支持了GRGC两个组成部分之间的预期分工:评论-侧OT校准可以减少群体崩溃,而政策-侧奖励的塑造则使得剩余的分组利润更可用于GRPO.

blocks.en: These figures also clarify why our method should not be interpreted as merely making rewards “larger” or “more extreme.” The goal is not to maximize separation indiscriminately, but to keep prompt groups neither collapsed nor dominated by uninformative near-ties. In this regime, grouped optimization can exploit reward differences more reliably and with fewer pathological updates.
blocks.zh: 这些数字也澄清了为什么我们的方法不应被解释为只是使奖励“更大”或“更极端”。 目标不是不分青红皂白地最大限度地分离,而是使迅速分裂的团体既不崩溃,也不被无信息化的接近于主宰。 在这个制度中,分组优化可以更可靠地利用奖励差异,减少病理更新。

blocks.en: G.5 GPT-OSS Evaluation Results
blocks.zh: G.5 GPT-OSS 评价结果

blocks.en: We further evaluate the LMSYS-trained models with GPT-OSS-120B as an additional automatic judge, in order to check whether the observed gains depend on the specific Qwen2.5-72B evaluation model used in the main experiments. The evaluation follows the same automatic protocol described in Appendix F : the judge assigns scalar scores to the student response and the reference response, from which we compute the normalized score and win rate; the only change is that GPT-OSS is used as the judge model. Table 15 shows the same trend under this alternative evaluator. For Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct, GRGC improves the score from 56.41 56.41 with GAD to 60.52 60.52 , and raises the win rate from 50.1 % 50.1\% to 60.8 % 60.8\% . The improvement is even larger for Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct, where GRGC improves the score from 55.56 55.56 to 59.77 59.77 and the win rate from 47.6 % 47.6\% to 59.9 % 59.9\% . These results indicate that the advantage of GRGC is not tied to a single judge model: the better reward geometry learned during adversarial distillation translates into responses that are also preferred by an independent GPT-OSS evaluator.
blocks.zh: 我们进一步评价使用GPT-OSS-120B作为额外自动判断器的LMSYS训练模型,以检查观测到的收益是否取决于主要实验中使用的具体Quen2.5-72B评价模型. 评审遵循附录F描述的相同自动协议:裁判员为学生响应和参考响应分配scalar分数,我们从中计算出常态分数和胜率;唯一的变化是GPT-OSS被用作裁判模型. 表15显示这一替代评价人员的趋势相同。 对于Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct,GRGC将比分由56.4156.41与GAD提升到60.52-60.52,并将得分率从50.1%50.1\%提高到60.8%60.8\%. Quen2.5-1.5B-Instruct的改进更大,GRGC的改进分数从55.56 55.56分提高到59.77 59.77分,胜率从47.6% 47.6\%提高到59.9% 59.9\%. 这些结果表明,GRGC的优势并不与单一的判官模型挂钩:在对抗性蒸馏过程中所学得的更好奖励几何学转化为同样为独立的GPT-OSS评价者所偏爱的反应.

blocks.en: Table 15: GPT-OSS-120B evaluation results on the LMSYS test set. We report the averaged GPT-OSS-120B evaluation score and win rate.
blocks.zh: 表15:LMSYS测试集的GPT-OSS-120B评价结果. 我们报告GPT-OSS-120B的平均评价得分和胜率。

blocks.en: G.6 Analysis of Token Length
blocks.zh: G.6 对托肯长度的分析

blocks.en: Table 16: Average response length (token length) of different methods and models on the LMSYS test set. The models are trained using the LMSYS-Chat training set with the GPT-5-Chat teacher.
blocks.zh: 表16 LMSYS测试集上不同方法和模型的平均响应长度(token长度). 这些模型使用与GPT-5-Chat教师的LMSYS-Chat培训集进行训练.

blocks.en: Table 16 reports average response length as a behavioral diagnostic rather than as a direct quality metric. A good distilled student should avoid both severe under-generation, which often indicates missing content or truncated reasoning, and unnecessary verbosity, which often reflects repetitive or weakly controlled generation. From this perspective, GRGC is attractive because its response length remains much closer to the teacher than GAD while avoiding the strong length inflation that appears in standard adversarial distillation. SeqKD, by contrast, tends to produce shorter responses, which is consistent with its reliance on static teacher trajectories and its tendency to under-explore during on-policy rollout.
blocks.zh: 表16将平均反应长度作为行为诊断而不是直接的质量衡量标准。 优秀的蒸馏学生既应避免严重不足的生成,这往往表明缺少内容或短篇推理,也应避免不必要的动词,这往往反映重复或控制薄弱的生成. 从这个角度看,GRGC具有吸引力,因为它的反应长度仍然比GAD更接近教师,同时避免了标准对抗性蒸馏中出现的强烈长度通胀. 相比之下,SeqKD往往产生较短的响应,这符合其对静态教师轨迹的依赖,也符合其在政策推出期间的开发不足倾向.

blocks.en: This result fits the broader interpretation of GRGC. Reward geometry conditioning does not simply encourage the student to speak more; rather, it provides a better-conditioned optimization signal so that the student can allocate response length more appropriately. In our experiments, this translates into outputs whose lengths remain closer to the teacher’s response budget while still achieving higher automatic and human-evaluation performance.
blocks.zh: 这一结果符合对《全球资源公约》的更广泛解释。 奖励几何条件并不简单地鼓励学生多说话;相反,它提供了一个条件更好的优化信号,使学生能够更适当地分配响应长度. 在我们的实验中,这转化为产出,其长度仍然更接近于教师的反应预算,而同时又实现了更高的自动和人评价性能。

blocks.en: G.7 Rule-based Instruction Following on IFEval
blocks.zh: G.7 关于IFEval的基于规则的指示

blocks.en: We evaluate instruction following on IFEval [ 97 ] , whose verifiable constraints are scored by deterministic rule-based checkers rather than an LLM judge. Table 17 reports prompt-level strict and loose accuracy. GRGC achieves the best result at both student scales: relative to GAD, it improves strict/loose accuracy by 1.80 / 2.28 1.80/2.28 points for Qwen2.5-1.5B and 2.63 / 3.48 2.63/3.48 points for Qwen2.5-3B. These results provide judge-free evidence that the gains extend to verifiable instruction compliance.
blocks.zh: 我们评价关于IFEval[97]的指示,其可核查的限制因素是由基于规则的确定性检查器而不是一个LLM法官评分的。 表17报告准确性迅速、严格和松散。 GRGC在两个学生级别上都取得了最佳成绩:相对于GAD,它提高了严格/低精度,Quen2.5-1.5B的比分为1.80/2.28 1.80/2.28分,Quen2.5-3B的比分为2.63/3.48 2.63/3.48分. 这些结果提供了无法官证据,证明收益延伸到可核查的指令遵守情况。

blocks.en: Table 17: Rule-based IFEval accuracy (%) under strict and loose verification.
blocks.zh: 表17:严格和松散的核查中基于规则的IFEval精确度(%)。

blocks.en: G.8 Long-form Mathematical Reasoning
blocks.zh: G.8 长式数学理由

blocks.en: We further test GRGC outside open-ended chat by sampling 30,000 training problems from OpenR1-Math-220k [ 98 ] , which provides DeepSeek-R1-generated reasoning trajectories [ 21 ] . We train Qwen2.5-1.5B with a 10,000-token maximum sequence length for teacher trajectories, student rollouts, and critic scoring; many teacher and student outputs exceed 8,000 tokens. We evaluate benchmark accuracy on Minerva Math [ 99 ] and 340 retained Gaokao-MathQA questions from AGIEval [ 100 ] , both of which have deterministic reference answers.
blocks.zh: 我们进一步通过采样来自OpenR1-Math-220k [98] 的3万个训练问题,在开放式聊天之外测试GRGC,这提供了DeepSeek-R1生成的推理轨迹[21]. 我们训练的Quen2.5-1.5B 具有10000个最大序列长度,用于教师的轨迹、学生的推出和评论评分;许多师生产出超过8000个符号。 我们评价Minerva Math的基准准确性[99],340保留了来自AGIEval的Gaokao-MathQA问题[100],两者都有决定性的参考答案.

blocks.en: Table 18 shows that GRGC achieves the highest accuracy on both benchmarks. It improves over GAD by 2.58 2.58 points on Minerva Math and 3.53 3.53 points on Gaokao-MathQA, while exceeding the undistilled student by 6.25 6.25 and 5.59 5.59 points, respectively. The gains therefore persist under domain-specific supervision, ground-truth evaluation, and long reasoning trajectories beyond the response lengths used in our chat experiments.
blocks.zh: 表18显示,GRGC在两个基准上都达到了最高的准确度. 它比GAD在Minerva Math上提高了2.582.58分,在Gaokao-MathQA上提高了3.533.53分,同时分别比未注册学生高出6.256.25分和5.595.59分. 因此,在针对具体领域的监督、地面真相评估以及超出我们聊天实验中使用的反应长度的长推理轨迹下,这些收益依然存在。
